text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —La~ la~ La la la~...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, sounds great! Superb playing as 
always, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... thanks. I think I can manage to 
play this song pretty cleanly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My goodness~, you both play so 
wonderfully. I must get myself fired up as 
well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After all, I want our performance at the 
upcoming Mejiro family party to be truly 
splendid~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You got that right! The three of us are 
gonna deliver the best ensemble ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright, you're on violin, right? ...It 
brings back memories of when we took 
lessons together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how nostalgic~. Let us devote 
ourselves to practice just like the old 
days~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... as slow and steady as ever, huh. 
You haven't changed a bit since we were 
kids.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
People used to tell you that you're way 
too laid-back all the time, didn't they? 
...Though I've always loved your gentle 
tone, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is an ensemble, so... I wonder 
if you can match the tempo of the piece...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please do not worry~. I have put careful 
thought into how to keep pace with you 
both~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for preparing the metronome. 
With this, I shall surely memorize the 
brisk tempo~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start on the faster side 
then... I'll set it to allegro.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tick, tick, tick, tick—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what an impatient little fellow~. 
Right, left, right... r-right, left...—?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're falling behind, falling 
behind...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Next, special training with this one. 
Please assist me, Onee-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Let's learn the rhythm 
with your whole body to the sound of these 
maracas!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! Uh~...! Mambo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: One, two~. One, two~. Uh~... mambo~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hrmm... I think that might be a bit too 
slow~...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hohhh~...~. Thank you so much for keeping 
me company like this~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. ...Though we 
didn't even get to practicing the actual 
song yet. I hope we make it in time for 
the real thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I simply must practice 
more~. And to do that... oh, of course~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, let us sleep enveloped in 
soothing aroma~. And then, we shall work 
hard again tomorrow~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahaha! Yeah, pushing yourself 
when your body is tired is strictly 
forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Bright really is amazing. If it were 
me, I'd definitely be panicking by now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... but you see, I am lo~oking forward 
to it so very much. Performing together 
with Ryan-oneesama, Dober, and everyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As a horse girl of the Mejiro family, I 
will see it through to the end without 
fail. Ei, ei, oh~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From then on, Mejiro Bright continued her 
days of instrument practice. Until one 
day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of all the checks, doesn't 
it. Still... seeing it all gathered 
together is truly breathtaking, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day~. What might you two be doing 
here today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh... my goodness~! Look at all these 
trophies and victory sashes~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Autumn 'Tenno Sho', and over here the 
'Arima Kinen'... These are all cherished 
treasures of the Mejiro family, aren't 
they~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we will be displaying them at the 
upcoming party. ...After all, they 
represent the glorious history of the 
Mejiro family, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it all again, the Mejiro family 
really is something else. Man~, it sure is 
a heavy banner to carry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...However, with McQueen-sama and 
Palmer-sama around, I believe there is no 
need for worry~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Both of you possess a radiance truly 
worthy of the Mejiro family, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-sama's nobility, disciplining 
herself to be the epitome of a Mejiro—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And Palmer-sama's inspiring fortitude, 
facing adversity with optimism and 
overcoming it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The shimmering brilliance you both have... 
is something I deeply admire~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Admire, huh... man, you got me. When you 
say it so straight-faced like that, I 
can't even play humble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, desu wa. Recognizing us as worthy 
of being Mejiro horse girls... brings 
great joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, each and every one of you 
radiates such a wonderful light...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa— WOOOOOHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not yet...! Give it everything you've got! 
Until the muscles scream that they've 
reached their limit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ............Ryan-oneesama...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-oneesama too... and Dober, 
Ardan-sama, Ramonu-sama as well. They all 
possess a unique strength that is entirely 
their own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Which means, I too must...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I must do my absolute best at the 
upcoming party~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, at this rate we might actually 
make it in time for the real show...! This 
is the fruit of Bright's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two, got a sec!? I was surprised 
to hear this myself, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For the Mejiro family party entertainment, 
one of the groups couldn't make the 
schedule, so the number of performances 
got cut down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...After all the excitement for the 
party, it might end in the blink of an 
eye...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Hmmmmmm~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I know~. What if we were to perform 
another song together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Add another performance from us... Yeah, I 
feel like that would really liven things 
up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I agree, but... Bright, will you be okay? 
Taking on another song on top of this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, honestly I am not very okay at 
all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even so... it is what I wish to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I booked a room at the karaoke place by 
the station. They said playing instruments 
is totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really sure you'll be okay on 
your own, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall be just fine~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Being slow and easygoing, I simply must 
put in twice the effort of anyone else. 
That is just who I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, let us play a 
wonderful melody together. ...Well then, I 
shall be on my way~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Twice the effort, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And following through with that 
completely... is what makes Bright so 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter the circumstances, calmly 
reaching the goal without ever breaking 
stride—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That is Bright's unique way to shine, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Let's have faith in Bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I was invited to attend a 
Mejiro family party as a trainer guest—

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text:
—And now for our final performance. 
Distinguished guests, please enjoy.
choice_data_list:
The finale is an ensemble by the Mejiro 
family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Dober, Ryan-onesama. ...Let us show them 
all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(The majesty of the Mejiro family— and our 
unyielding pride!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Descending upon the foot of Ezo Fuji 
—Children of light

text_block_list.name: Attendee
text_block_list.text:
This melody... is truly magnificent. It 
feels as though timeless history is 
flowing through us...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro, Mejiro —Along the path of glory

text_block_list.name: Attendee
text_block_list.text:
So this is the prestigious Mejiro 
family... Such, such radiant splendor...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an awe-inspiring performance... 
Still feeling lightheaded with emotion, I 
stepped out into the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! Amazing, my body's still burning 
up! To think we could create such perfect 
harmony...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... thank you both so much~. Without 
your strength, I'm sure I'd still be 
playing along ever so leisurely~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true. We made it this far 
all thanks to your power, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone felt it. —Bright's true 
radiance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu. In that case, did I manage to 
get a little closer~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To the light of Mejiro... just like 
everyone else.
